cs.t: A minimal laptop bag (Tomtoc). Switching from the big Swissgear backpack forced me to stop lugging multiple devices, dongles, keyboards, etc. Better for my back and better for my focus. A (under $50 refurb) Apple Magic Keyboard 2. I was always struggling with muscle memory on different keyboard layouts so having something that's 95% identical to my MBP keyboard helped a lot. Linode $5/month servers. Couldn't be happier with them as a place to park all those little sites for friends and side projects, mostly running Wordpress.
cs.th: Ask HN: Your most useful purchase of under $100 in 2018?
